_note: The PureScript compiler by pinned hash (2026-09-17): scripts/toolchain.py downloads the asset for this platform from the release, verifies the tarball against `sha256`, takes purescript/purs out of it and verifies the binary against `purs_sha256` — so a copy already in local/bin is re-verified without a download. A version bump edits this file and nothing else; tests/py/test_toolchain.py holds the shape and the verify road. The pins were taken from the release and the linux binary cross-checked byte-for-byte against the npm package's purs.bin of the same version before it was retired.
